{{Quote|I have a breath mask from the bridge firepac.|Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
A '''firepac''', also known as an '''emergency firefighter pack''', was a kit used during fires and other atmospheric emergencies. Among the many items it contained was a full-face [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] with a built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and an emergency [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] supply, allowing the user to breathe safely in smoke-filled environments. Firepacs were a bright orange in color.<ref name="COO" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the senior bridge officer of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], used a firepac after smoke and gas filled one of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] areas as a result of sabotage by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]].<ref name="COO" />
